public_rationale: The filings confirm that the historical $4.9 billion input was Amazon-wide cash capex. They do not identify cumulative early AWS spending. Modern company-wide capex is available, but the missing AWS allocation and inconsistent possible treatments of leases and proceeds prevent a matching inflation-adjusted comparison. The illustrative calculation does not establish the claim, and its weakness does not prove the broader comparison false.
limitations: No conclusion is proposed on the opinion that AWS was a bargain.
A smaller historical company-wide annual figure does not by itself establish cumulative AWS costs.
The 2025 comparator is the budget known at publication, not later realized expenditure.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Even when factoring in inflation, the capital expenditure behind Amazon Web Services was a bargain and a fraction of Amazon's total capital expenditures in 2024 or 2025.

statement.excerpt: And to be clear, the actual capital expenditure numbers are likely much lower, but I want to make it clear that even when factoring in inflation, Amazon Web Services was A) a bargain and B) a fraction of the cost of what Amazon has spent in 2024 or 2025.

our_interpretation: The checkable core compares cumulative early AWS buildout spending through the 2015 profitability disclosure with Amazon's total annual capex in 2024 or its 2025 budget known at publication.
I use 2006–2015 as the approximate early-buildout window implied by the surrounding nine-or-ten-year example; its exact endpoints are not supplied.
The plain reading of a fraction is materially less, without imposing an unstated ratio.
The $67.6 billion calculation is expressly illustrative, not an observed AWS expenditure total.
Bargain is an evaluative judgment. Inflation adjustment is a measurement requirement, not a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: A defensible historical AWS expenditure series, adjusted into comparable dollars, establishes that cumulative early buildout capex was materially below Amazon's 2024 annual capex and/or its contemporaneous 2025 budget.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable historical evidence establishes that inflation-adjusted cumulative AWS buildout capex was not materially below the relevant annual comparator. An error in the illustrative calculation alone does not settle the broader claim.
